note: DT.1l: Dart client models. A Flutter-style Dart client (Dio) reads club members from a gin API. The Dart Member model's JSON names are its hand-written fromJson subscript keys (j['display_name']), not its field names, so its SCHEMA_FIELDS (format dart) list memberId / handle / display_name / badges. Each Dio call's shape is read inside its one calling method: get() applies Member.fromJson to res.data (a direct Member response), list() casts res.data to a map and maps Member.fromJson over raw['members'] (an envelope {members: Member[]}), rename() sends a data: map literal ({handle, reason}). The gin side writes *models.Member (Get), gin.H{members: []models.Member} (List) and binds an anonymous {handle} (Rename). So the models pass pairs the Dart Member with models.Member as an http_model SAME_AS class, diverged: display_name is a client-only optional name (json_field_optional_absent) and the server's displayName goes unread (json_field_unread); the PUT request's reason is dropped (json_field_dropped). MemberService and the Members handler type are never model identities.
